repos_data.description: Local speech-to-text for macOS  on-device AI, fully private, optional cloud
🎙️ AI Dictation App - Open Source and Local-first ⚡ Type 3x faster, no keyboard needed. 🆓 Powered by open source models, works offline, fast and accurate.
Free, open source voice dictation for macOS. On-device transcription with Apple's Speech framework. No cloud/no API keys/no account.
Private, local transcription and system-wide dictation for Apple Silicon.

Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish on your Mac with EG-1 or S1-mini by Superwhisper, Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini/Claude key. Snippets, custom words, no account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.

Thai + English voice typing for Mac. Offline speech-to-text that types Thai-spoken tech words in English. Push-to-talk dictation on Apple Silicon (Whisper + MLX), free & open-source Wispr Flow alternative · พิมพ์ด้วยเสียงภาษาไทย

Your personal context engine for macOS, with Windows and Linux in alpha: on-device meeting notes, screen recall, dictation, and autocomplete that you and your AI agents can search. Free and open source (GPLv3).

Push-to-talk voice typing for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. On-device or cloud speech recognition, AI polish with presets, a dictionary, rules and scenes, long recordings with subtitles; the phone works on its own or pairs end-to-end encrypted as the computer's microphone and keyboard.
Open-source macOS dictation that turns speech into polished text in the app you're already using. Powered by AssemblyAI.
Mac-native dictation that just works – lives in the notch, zero setup, free forever

Voice dictation menu-bar app for macOS. Press a hotkey, speak, transcript appears at the cursor. Whisper runs locally via WhisperKit on Apple Silicon — no audio, text, or telemetry leaves your Mac. MIT, Swift.
Fast, private push-to-talk dictation for Apple Silicon Macs — local Parakeet TDT v3, no cloud or telemetry.
Source-available voice dictation for macOS, free for personal use. On-device WhisperKit transcription with optional LLM cleanup.
Scriptable local dictation that uses the text on your screen to fix names, and your rules to format numbers, dates, and links.
Native Mac dictation in a 12 MB download. Free Local mode with Whisper + Parakeet, reproducible benchmarks, optional Cloud. MIT-licensed client.
Tiny android dictation app that turns speech into clear writing.
Transcribe meetings, calls and dictation locally on your Mac – with speaker recognition, no cloud. Whisper + pyannote, menu bar app. German and English.
Free, open-source offline dictation and transcription for macOS. Dictate into any app, transcribe calls and files on-device, and give Claude Code, Codex and Cursor ears via a local MCP server.
MIT-licensed voice dictation for macOS and Windows with local Whisper, Parakeet and Canary models, plus optional cloud transcription | Rust + Tauri

Free, open-source Mac app for local transcription and dictation. Transcribe audio, video, YouTube and meetings with Whisper or Parakeet, fully offline. A MacWhisper and Wispr Flow alternative for Apple Silicon.

Free, open-source macOS menu bar dictation that never leaves your Mac. Fast on-device speech-to-text (voice typing) for German & English. 100% offline & private alternative to Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, and MacWhisper.
Local dictation for macOS. Hold a key, speak, and the transcript is pasted at the caret. Recognition runs entirely on your Mac.

Offline dictation and file transcription for the Mac, in Rust. Works with NVIDIA's Parakeet models, other Parakeet models from Hugging Face, or Apple Speech. About 0.5 GB of memory with Parakeet Ultra loaded.
Dictate, edit, and generate text in any Mac app. On-device by default.
